bio.text: Christian Celeste Tate is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 54 in Brooklyn in the November 3, 2026 general election, after defeating incumbent Erik Dilan in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
City & State reported in June 2026 that Tate had been involved with Brooklyn Community Board 4, where he became first vice chair.

sources.title: Christian Celeste Tate's notifications are going crazy after his Assembly win
